title: Sources: Shanghai-based AI startup MiniMax plans to price its Hong Kong IPO at ~$21, the top of its marketed range, and will stop taking orders a day early (Dave Sebastian/Bloomberg)
summary: Dave Sebastian / Bloomberg: Sources: Shanghai-based AI startup MiniMax plans to price its Hong Kong IPO at ~$21, the top of its marketed range, and will stop taking orders a day early — MiniMax plans to price its Hong Kong initial public offering at the top of the marketed range, people familiar with the matter said …
